data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of GBP 5.6 million in prior year reserves, primarily due to an additional risk premium applied to close the 2020 year of account into the 2021 year of account. This strengthening was part of managing uncertainty in reserve estimates. The 2022 financial year was significantly impacted by geopolitical events like the Russia-Ukraine Conflict, which resulted in a net loss of GBP 19.7 million, and several natural catastrophe events, notably Hurricane Ian with a net loss of GBP 51.2 million. The syndicate also holds reserves for COVID-19 losses from 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. Inflationary pressures were explicitly considered in the reserving process.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 5.6m is explicitly stated as an additional risk premium for the closure of the 2020 year of account, rather than a general portfolio-wide movement. The claims development triangle shows a net strengthening of GBP 1.525m for UW years 2016-2020, which is different from the stated GBP 5.6m, likely due to the specific nature of the GBP 5.6m closure premium.
